sentences.text: This is first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant who has been arrested relating to FIR/Crime No.437/2023 dated 11.07.2023 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Betul, for offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(N), 506, 34 of IPC and Sections 5, 5L/6 of the POCSO Act (as mentioned in the application).

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 30.01.2023 and the Dashan Dhurve vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34612269/
1 trial will take considerable time to conclude.

sentences.text: He further submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
The applicant is a permanent resident of district and is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by the Court.
Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
In this case, the age of the prosecutrix at the time of incident was more than 17 years.
It is claimed by her in the FIR that she was sexually abused by applicant on the false pretext of marriage.
Leaned counsel for the applicant submitted Annexure-A/3 which is the marriage certificate issued on 26.08.2023 regarding solemnization of marriage between the applicant and prosecutrix.

Having considered these facts, this Court deems it fit to release the applicant on bail, therefore,
without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of the trial.

It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE sjk Dashan Dhurve vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34612269/
